title: Поддержка верного совмещения: мягкий вес размера (H2) и устойчивая переоценка внутри клики (H3)
fixed_before: Every TCAFF run of variants G2, S2, R3 and every analysis of T0 and T3.0. Only T2.0 (size-similarity AUC on the 798 labels) was computed earlier; its criterion was written to a file at 2026-10-17T17:40:34Z before computing and is recorded below unchanged.

problem.summary: In B0 the filter never accepts a wrong mode: 1 - Acc = 0.233 = 0.110 (no estimate before first acceptance) + 0.083 (t <= 1 m, |yaw| > 5 deg) + 0.040 (t > 1 m); accepted errors are bounded by 1.40 m / 10.0 deg. Identity evidence enters only through a binary size gate with P(admit|same) = 54/314 = 0.172 and P(admit|different) = 37/341 = 0.109 (LR+ = 1.58); uniform relaxation alpha = 2 trades cold-start no-decision 40/60 -> 25/60 for wrong first decisions 4/60 -> 10/60. Only 66% of B0 CLIPPER correspondences link objects within 0.5 m in the world, and the measurement is a one-shot weighted least squares over the whole clique (breakdown point 0). Removing true support (U3, section 9) produced persistent wrong modes.

tcaff_parameters: vendor/tcaff/demo/params/tcaff_mot_dataset.yaml (release), authors' saved detections; changes only as listed per variant; vendor code unchanged, variants are applied by patching classes at runtime (scripts/support/patches.py)

B0.rule: Release gate alpha = 1, unchanged TCAFF. Full recording: the 5 existing repeats results/segment_unit/unit_test/runs/B0 (same harness, detections and parameters). Cold start: rerun in this protocol.

G2.rule: Gate relaxed to alpha = 2 (wh_scale_diff 1.7, h_diff 0.2 m); no weights. Same as the alpha = 2 variant of section 6.

S2.rule: Gate alpha = 2 plus size similarity in the CLIPPER affinity: s(a,b) = sqrt(r_w r_h), r_f = min(f_a,f_b)/max(f_a,f_b) from the map widths/heights used by the gate; for every off-diagonal entry M_uv > 0: M'_uv = (M_uv * s(u) * s(v))^(1/3) (geometric mean, ROMAN eq. 3); diagonal stays 1, zero entries and the constraint matrix unchanged; MNO zeroing and the max_opt_fraction score use M'.

R3.rule: Gate alpha = 1; each CLIPPER solution is re-estimated by graduated non-convexity with the Geman-McClure loss (Yang et al., RA-L 2020): start from WLS(C) with the release recency weights; residual r = ||p_a - T p_b|| (XY); robust weights g = (mu c^2 / (r^2 + mu c^2))^2 multiply the recency weights; mu starts at 2 max(r^2)/c^2 and is divided by 1.4 per iteration down to 1, where a last weighted fit is made; c = 0.5 m. The association set, the object count and all filters are unchanged.

design_change_before_fixing: A first draft used hard iterative trimming at 0.5 m. A synthetic unit test (12 points, 3 shifted by 1-2 m) showed that the biased WLS start pushes every residual above 0.5 m, so the rule falls back to WLS and cannot act. Replaced by GNC Geman-McClure before this file was committed and before any real data were processed with either rule.
constants_origin: alpha = 2 is the value selected in section 6 on development; c = 0.5 m equals the world-distance radius of the identity proxy of section 8.3; the GNC factor 1.4 follows Yang et al. 2020; the geometric-mean fusion and the min/max ratio follow ROMAN. Nothing is tuned on results of this protocol.
repeat_note: CLIPPER uses std::random_device; repeats are independent runs

T0.metric: for steps before the first acceptance with GT: share of steps with at least one MNO measurement and share with at least one measurement within 1 m and 5 deg of GT, per directed pair

T2.0.role: H2 mechanism, computed before this protocol
T2.0.metric: ROC AUC of s on same_object vs different_objects labels, 95% CI by cluster bootstrap over 24 episodes
T2.0.pass: lower CI bound > 0.5 on all labelled pairs and on gate-rejected pairs

T2.1.data: full recording, harness of section 9 (run with capture and replay verification)

T3.0.data: captures (maps) of the 5 B0 repeats, every 5th step with an accepted estimate and GT
T3.0.procedure: rerun the release MNO-CLIPPER on the captured maps; for every solution passing the release filters compute z_WLS (unchanged code path) and z_R3 on the same correspondences; in-mode measurements: z_WLS within 2 m and 15 deg of GT
T3.0.metric: paired difference in the share of in-mode measurements within 1 m and 5 deg (R3 minus WLS); 95% CI by cluster bootstrap over directed pair x repeat (2000 resamples)
reported: oracle: WLS on correspondences with residual <= 0.5 m under the GT transform (ceiling, uses GT)
AUC of the WLS residual for oracle membership
median |yaw| and translation error of in-mode measurements

cold_start.data: the 12 holdout windows of section 6.4 on the frozen author maps (scripts/size_gate_evaluate.py run_episode, unchanged)
cold_start.consistency_check: fresh B0 and G2 are compared with the saved section 6.4 results (4/60 and 10/60 wrong first; 40/60 and 25/60 no first decision); comparisons below use the fresh runs

metrics.primary: Acc: share of all pair updates with an estimate within 1 m and 5 deg of GT
decomposition: U_pre: share of updates before the first acceptance
secondary: mean of per-pair mean translation and yaw error
share of accepted estimates with |yaw| > 10 deg

decision_rules.range: range(X) = max - min of the metric over the 5 repeats of variant X; a difference 'exceeds the ranges' when it is larger than max(range(X), range(Y))
decision_rules.H2: Supported if all hold: (1) T2.0 passed; (2) mean Acc(S2) - mean Acc(B0) exceeds the ranges and mean Acc(S2) - mean Acc(G2) exceeds the ranges; (3) cold start: wrong first(S2) <= wrong first(B0) and no first(S2) < no first(B0); (4) cold-start runtime(S2) <= 1.25 x runtime(G2). Otherwise not supported.
decision_rules.H3: Supported if all hold: (1) T3.0: lower 95% CI bound of the paired difference > 0; (2) mean Acc(R3) - mean Acc(B0) exceeds the ranges; (3) mean (E_psi + E_t)(B0) - mean (E_psi + E_t)(R3) exceeds the ranges; (4) mean U_pre(R3) - mean U_pre(B0) <= 1 percentage point; (5) cold start: wrong first(R3) <= wrong first(B0). Otherwise not supported.

independence: One recording; the problem statement was derived from B0, section 6 and section 8-9 results of the same recording. This is a test of fixed rules, not an evaluation on unseen data. The 12 holdout windows were seen in section 6.
excluded: variant without any size information (all-to-all candidates, VISTA-style control): about 10^4 candidate associations per step, not feasible in the available time; reported as a limitation
robustness of S2 to frontends with wrong modes (R0, U3)
changes to the temporal filter, epsilon, sigma, MNO budget
retuning c, alpha or the fusion after seeing results
